params.desc: Embedding model name or ID.

params.desc: Format to return the embeddings in (float or base64).

examples.title: cURL
Python (OpenAI Client)
examples.code:
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url='http://localhost:8000/v1', api_key='sk-no-key-required')

response = client.embeddings.create(
    model="bge-m3-onnx",
    input=["The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog", "Artificial intelligence is transforming software"]
)

print(f"Generated {len(response.data)} embeddings!")
print(f"Dimension: {len(response.data[0].embedding)}")

endpoints.desc: Unified Audio API endpoint for speech-to-text, text-to-speech, voice conversion, speaker diarization, and multimodal audio execution.

params.name: model
params.desc: Audio model ID or 'auto' to auto-detect active audio model.

params.name: task
params.desc: Exact task Enum (e.g. 'speech_to_text', 'text_to_speech', 'voice_conversion', 'speaker_diarization') or 'auto'.

params.name: instruction
params.desc: Optional prompt instruction for the audio model.

params.name: input_source
params.desc: Source data object specifying type ('url', 'base64', 'file', 'text') and data payload.

params.name: parameters
params.desc:
Task-Specific Hyperparameters Object:
• temperature (All): Randomness (0.0 = exact)
• language (STT/Translation): Source language ('hi', 'en', 'auto')
• speed (TTS): Voice playback rate (1.0 = normal)
• voice_id (TTS): Voice speaker persona ('alloy', 'echo')
• translate_to (Translation): Target language ('en', 'hi')
• timestamps (STT): Enable segment timestamps
• beam_size (STT): Decoding beam width (1-10)
• vad_filter (STT): Voice Activity Detection silence filter
• speaker_labels (Diarization): Enable speaker tagging

endpoints.request_payload:
{
  "model": "auto",
  "task": "auto",
  "instruction": "Transcribe this audio cleanly.",
  "input_source": {
    "type": "url",
    "data": "https://example.com/audio.mp3"
  },
  "keep_alive": null,
  "parameters": {
    "temperature": 0.0,
    "language": "",
    "speed": 1.0,
    "voice_id": "alloy",
    "translate_to": "",
    "timestamps": false,
    "beam_size": 5,
    "vad_filter": true,
    "speaker_labels": false
  }
}
